construct.claim: Programmable directional selector parity is ParityExistsP-complete as explicitly defined, even for disjoint paired-unit directions.
construct.scope: Unary n, explicit selector and direction matrix, Boolean source pool of nonempty width-three clauses; projected parity counts z, not witnesses.
construct.derivation: Fresh equality copies and paired unit flips pin projected bits exactly; ordinary circuit-to-CNF reduction preserves existence; rank-deficient directions cancel.
unresolved_steps: Decision-preserving lower-bound transfer to ordinary SAT.
candidate_tests: All two-variable selected formulas and projection subsets; actual selector bitsets and paired directions.

alternative.claim: Computing parity of projected models via partial-pin existence oracles requires 2^h deterministic queries and (1-2epsilon)2^h expected distinct singleton queries with bounded error on full relation.
alternative.scope: Hidden outside selectors, queries only partial assignments to h address coordinates; full and one-hole compact CNFs.
alternative.derivation: Each hole differs from full relation only on its own singleton; couple random tapes and sum query probabilities; explicit prefix-OR CNF excludes one address.
unresolved_steps: Unrestricted algorithms with explicit access to formulas; decision lower bound.
candidate_tests: Actual one-hole CNFs, unique auxiliary extensions and all ternary pin queries.
